name: Thesh Khafre
source:
Thesh is a new student in Halifax High. He is in the same class as the MC. 
He is from Egypt. His body is covered in bandages. Indeed, he has a skin condition which these bandages both cover and aid.
Because of his illness he is forced to move very often; He enjoyed it because he could visit a lot of different countries, but as a result he was unable to form lasting frienships with anyone.
